**Window-Fire Damage Mapping**  

**Type B Room Units**  
- Main bedroom side windows exposed to extended re-entrant fire  
- Possible Fire starting locations: kitchens, corridors near gates, bathrooms, main bedrooms  

**Type A Room Units**  
- Living room windows exposed to extended re-entrant fire (near re-entrant, including hot smoke)  
- Possible Fire starting locations: kitchens, corridors near gates, living rooms
